A positive even-length sign sequence whose nonzero aperiodic autocorrelations have absolute value at most one must have length $2$ or $4$. The paper's classification of odd Barker lengths is outside this selected additional statement.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
exact_statement:
theorem even_length_eq_two_or_four {n : ℕ} (h : Fin n → ℤ)
    (hnpos : 0 < n) (hn : Even n) (hb : IsBarker h) : n = 2 ∨ n = 4
